title: Re-add lost API call for module download from the marketplace
issue_title: Re-add lost API call for module download from the marketplace
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
This PR fix a misunderstanding between two API calls to the marketplace. One is supposed to get module details (in JSON), the other one the module Zip content (binary). We bring back the second one in another name. |

### Steps to reproduce
Install a module available on the Marketplace. You should NOT have an error `Cannot store module content in temporary folder !` |

### Steps to reproduce

title: Fixed "print out" link display condition
issue_title: Fixed "print out" link display condition
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
Fix the display condition of "print out" link when an order return has a "waiting for package" state. |

### Steps to reproduce
Make sure order return feature is enabled first. Then create an order and change the status to "Delivered" so you can create an order return. Create an order return on customer's side.
